name: Stock Tracker
description: Indices, stocks and commodities with earnings, macro events, analyst estimates, financials and news on the chart.

store.tagline: Indices, stocks and commodities with earnings, macro events and news on the chart.
store.description:
Market dashboard for 5 indices, 20 large-cap US stocks and 6 commodities.

• Line or candle charts from 1D to Max, with pinch and trackpad zoom
• Earnings, ex-dividend dates and macro releases (FOMC, CPI, GDP, BoE, ECB, OPEC) on the date axis; tap for details
• The three most important news stories of the month on the chart (FT, Reuters, Bloomberg, WSJ, CNBC and more)
• Earnings history with SEC filings, estimate vs reported EPS and analyst forecast ranges
• Revenue, net income, margins, debt/equity and ratios
• Optional Trading 212 portfolio view

Refreshes daily from free public data sources (CNBC, Nasdaq, SEC EDGAR, Google News). Not investment advice.
